TITLE: Sales Tax Collected – An Invoice Partly Paid by a Deposit Shows as "Paid" and Is Missing from the "Partially Paid" Filter
TYPE: Story Defect · PARENT: SV-4573 (also link "relates to" SV-4573) · PRIORITY: Medium
STATUS: DRAFT — NOT FILED. Ready to file once the QA lead gives the go-ahead for this ticket (the Jira creation hold is active).
ALREADY REPORTED: none (JQL read live 28 Oct 2026).
BASIS: SV-4573, "Invoice Status (, Partially Paid, Paid)".
REPRODUCED: twice on staging build v26.43.2-f8698cb, 28 Oct 2026, the second time entirely through the screen; 9 older invoices show the same thing.

h2. Description

*On the Sales Tax Collected report, an invoice that a deposit has only partly paid shows as "Paid".* The invoice itself still shows money owed, and other reports call it partially paid. Because the report calls it "Paid", choosing *Invoice Status: Partially Paid* leaves the invoice out, so the shop cannot see it among the invoices that still owe money.

This only happens when part of the money came from a deposit. When part of the money comes from an ordinary payment, the report correctly shows "Partially Paid".

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin and choose the location *DVI Test* in the top bar.
# Click *Work Orders*, then create a new work order for any customer.
# On the *Lines* tab, add one labour line priced at *$135.00* and approve it.
# Mark the line *Complete*.
# Open the *Finance* tab.
# Click *Add Deposit*.
# Choose *Payment Method: Cash* and enter *Deposit Amount: 30.00*.
# Click *Record Deposit*.
# Click *Create Invoice*.
# Check the Finance tab: *Payments* shows $30.00 and *Balance* shows *$105.00*.
# Click *Reports*, then *Sales Tax Collected* (under Finance).
# Click the date filter and choose *Today*.
# Find the new invoice and look at its *Invoice Status*.
# Click the *Invoice Status* filter and choose *Partially Paid*.

*Actual Result:*
* At step 13 the invoice's Invoice Status reads *Paid*, even though $105.00 is still owed.
* At step 14 the table says *"No record matches these filters"*. The invoice is not listed.

*Expected Result:*
* At step 13 the invoice's Invoice Status reads *Partially Paid*, because $105.00 of the $135.00 is still owed.
* At step 14 the invoice is listed under *Partially Paid*.
